conditions: Alad V only drops the three component blueprints; the main blueprint is a Market purchase.

groups.meta: ~4 kills for Systems; 1-2 min a kill
conditions: Zanuka must die before Alad can. Strip Alad's shields, switch to Zanuka and kill it, then finish Alad. Downing Alad first lets Zanuka revive him.
Do not use Toxin on Alad; it bypasses the shields the fight is built around.
Do not knock Zanuka off the catwalks; Alad is unkillable until it respawns. If Alad is stuck in a wall, abort and rerun.
bonuses: Trinity's Well of Life locks Zanuka down, and Nyx's Chaos keeps it away long enough for Alad to bleed out.

disclosures.title: nothing is taking damage
disclosures.body: Players stuck here were on unmodded starter weapons. A Hek, Rubico or Vectis with mods makes the fight fold. The long-running T-pose bug, where Alad's health bar is already on screen at mission start, makes both die in a few hits; take the free kill.

disclosures.title: Circuit, if Systems will not drop
disclosures.body: After The Duviri Paradox, pick Valkyr in the normal Circuit during week 5 of the 11-week rotation, alongside Nekros and Oberon. Neuroptics at tier 2, Chassis 5, Systems 8, main blueprint 10.
